decisions.reason: The vertigo combination tablet sits close to the core offer and is presented on its own page; in a growing industry with the firm expanding and investing, it likely meets aspirations, and slack supports carrying it through early uncertainty.

The generic antidepressant is distant from the core and faces price pressure from reimbursement contracts, which raises the risk of falling short of aspirations, but its own product page and the firm's available slack make retention more likely within one year.

The combination antihypertensive line with several models is close to the established cardiovascular offer and is well presented, so it likely performs satisfactorily and gives no trigger for problemistic search.

The supplement fits the strategy of pharmacy-exclusive self-care products and builds on the existing offer, though its mere mention on the website suggests lower visibility and a modestly higher chance of being cut if results disappoint.
